H1.source: section 6.3, verbatim: 'improve on at least two stages with none regressing'
H1.what_is_NOT_yet_fixed: WHICH four stages. 6.3 uses 'the four mouth-stage evaluations' as a v1.0 term -- the plan's glossary says terms defined in v1.0 ('mouth stages' among them) keep their meanings -- and the v1.1 body does not enumerate them. The instrument that reports stages today is stage_of() in tools/heldout_eval.py, whose ladder is recall, recall_untraced, shape_arbiter, gating, mouth, plus the error classes engine_error and harness-bug. Five of those are pipeline stages, not four, so the denominator cannot be derived from the code either. Registered as D-MPE10-01: H1 is NOT SCOREABLE until the four stages are named, and naming them after seeing a run would set the denominator to suit the numerator.

H2.what_is_NOT_yet_fixed: the fluency metric. 6.3 says 'fluency improves' with no measure; the nine-axis table defines fluency as 'generation quality under staged failure evaluation', which is H1's instrument, not a scalar. Registered as D-MPE10-02: H2 needs a named scalar before it can be scored, and it must not be borrowed from whichever column wins.

H3.basis_for_the_5_0_pp: the same margin MP-E8 registered for retention (metrics.H1), so the two gates are commensurable and one organism is not being judged by two different tolerances for the same kind of drift. It is NOT derived from any MP-E10 measurement, of which there are none. The PI may revise it, but only before a run is scored.
H3.retention_must_hold_at: the R6 guarded battery, all four named probes still passing: P-numeral-final, R-count-moon, R-disj-reversed, R-order-ofthe. plan_source.transcribed_verbatim: 6.3 MP-E10 - The Mouth and the Second Timescale Objective. Replace unigram context with a native, contextual sequence organ, and extend consolidation from the proven 40-item scale to the MP-E8 tiers. The episodic-write and replay-consolidation legs of the original three-timescale design are considered covered at 40 items by ELECTRIC C2 and C3 and are not re-proven at toy scale; this experiment carries them to scale and builds the missing seconds-scale timescale. Architecture. Seconds - working memory: plasticize the central-complex loop into a decayed activation trace over the last k tokens; a fast-weight state computed by spread, replacing unigram context; parameterize k and register its sweep. Selection - two native routing variants, both flag-gated: variant (i) scores candidates by spread of the decayed state plus target-organ injection (the target organ already injects into speak_sentence and is hereby actually used for selection); variant (ii) routes candidates through carve as an allowed_pools mask, the version closest to existing machinery. One variant is registered primary, the other the ablation. Consolidation at scale - replay through the same local rule that wrote the engrams (Hebbian co-activation with Oja-style normalization) at tiers 120 and 300, with interference measured against the MP-E8 curriculum. ===== PAGE 18 ===== DROSO Master Plan v1.1 | Live Brain Protocol 15 Hypotheses. H1: the four mouth-stage evaluations improve on at least two stages with none regressing. H2: fluency improves over the MP-E8 arm-A baseline at the same tier. H3: replay at tier 300 holds retention at the invariant with interference bounded by the pre- registered margin. H4: the invariants hold; regression on either is a hard reject under R6. C-conditions. C1: any untraceable word in generated output - abort (R9). C2: guarded rows answered - abort. C3: retention or restart survival regresses - abort. C4: working- memory state leaks across a restart - abort by definition (it is seconds-scale). C5: one routing variant wins only with the other disabled - record as ablation result, not a win. Gate G3. Go only if H1-H4 hold. On failure: the bigram-era organ stays as the fallback arm, and the routing ablation data decides the next attempt. Agent brief. Implement both routing variants behind flags; ablate state-only, spread-only, and state-plus-spread; keep the legacy path runnable for comparison; replay at the registered tiers with the interference protocol; emit per-stage results, the k-sweep grid, and decision.md.

working_memory_step1.checklist_step: B.4 step 1: 'Plasticize the central-complex loop into the decayed working-memory trace; parameterize the window k; unit-test decay bounds and restart clearing.'
working_memory_step1.k_is_a_constructor_argument_not_a_choice: Nothing in the module picks k. The sweep grid [1,2,4,8,14,16,22] is registered in k_sweep and read from there by main(); the module would run with any k.
working_memory_step1.c4_as_code: Restart clearing is a test, not a sentence: test_restart_clearing_leaves_no_fingerprint_of_what_was_there compares the bytes of ring + fast-weight state + validity mask against a fresh trace. C4 says a leak is a definitional abort, and a definitional abort that only lives in a decision file guards nothing.
working_memory_step1.not_yet_done: No scored run. No curriculum, no tier, no hypothesis touched. The k-sweep at tier 40 as calibration is the next step and it is a timed measurement, so it runs alone.

result_quoting_guard_while_blocked.why: H1's denominator (which four mouth stages) is D-MPE10-01 and H2's scalar (what 'fluency' means) is D-MPE10-02. Both are open. A working-memory result measured while those are undecided can be reported as an organ characterisation, but it cannot be quoted as evidence for or against H1 or H2, because the quantity it would be quoted on has no definition yet.
result_quoting_guard_while_blocked.rule: While open_decisions_for_PI contains an UNRESOLVED D-MPE10-01 or D-MPE10-02: no MP-E10 working-memory or k-sweep figure may appear in any verdict sentence about H1 or H2, in this registration, in decision.md, or in any downstream document. Such figures may appear only under a heading that names them as organ characterisation, with the blocking decision id attached.
result_quoting_guard_while_blocked.what_this_does_not_do: It does not stop step 1's implementation or its unit tests, and it does not stop the k-sweep measurement itself -- the grid was registered before any treatment, so measuring it is not a post-hoc choice. It stops the QUOTING of a result as a hypothesis verdict.
